{{Top|leg}}
'''Siarr Tepinnnel''' was an outspoken critic of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Tepinnnel's subversive views came to the attention of the Authority's [[Security Division]] and Tepinnel's name was included on a [[The List|list]] of critics and other troublemakers compiled by the division's [[Executive Viceprex]], [[Mirkovig Hirken]]. Tepinnel was later arrested by the [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] and imprisoned at the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] penal facility.<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
